title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Parents at one practice
hook: Have your team's parents ever seen a full practice?
intro: They rarely see what happens at practice.
statement: Parents understand more when they see the work behind the games.
q1: Do you invite parents to one open practice —
q2: or keep practice for the players only?
q3: What would parents learn by watching?
t1: Both can work. But support grows
t2: when parents see how their kids are learning.
cta: Coaches — do you have open practices?
ctaLines: Once a season. Parents play too. Players only.
ctaPrompt: Share your practice habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Have your team's parents ever seen a full practice?
Parents see games every week. They rarely see what happens at practice.
Parents understand more when they see the work behind the games.
An open practice or players only. There is no single right way.
Do you have open practices? Share your habit in the comments.
